transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well... they brought me in. I didn't necessarily think I needed to come. 

It was just... something happened at the fair. I was giving my talk, and... I climbed up onto the tractor. I was just jerking the controls around to show the crowd the new pattern. That's all it was. But people started yelling at me to get down, and... I just couldn't make myself stop, even with them yelling. So... here I am.
When you were up on the tractor at the fair, did you see or hear anything that others might not have, or feel like something strange was happening around you?

Not at the fair, no. It's... well, mostly it's at home. Out by the north pasture. 

Usually around dusk, I... I hear voices. Coming right out of the irrigation lines. They just... they tell me things. Which rows are poisoned, which ones are blessed. And... it ain't just when I get all fired up like I was on that tractor, neither. Happens on quiet weeks, too. That's all.
Have you ever seen things that others don't, like shadows, figures, or anything unusual, especially when you're out by the north pasture?
No... no, I don't see anything. It's just the voices. I just hear them. That's all.
When you hear the voices talking to you, do they ever give you strange or unusual ideas that you believe are true, like someone is watching you or that you have special powers?

Well... I don't know about special powers or any of that. But... I do know things. 

Like with the farm. My wife, she'll bring out the lender's paperwork, try to show me it's all normal. But... I see the yield maps. The drone reports. The numbers are odd. They don't line up right. It's... it's a code. A warning. Folks are trying to take the farm out from under me. I just... I know it.
Do the voices ever talk about you specifically, like commenting on your actions or saying things that make you feel targeted or watched?
No. They don't... they don't say anything like that. Just about the crops. The rows. That's all.
Do you believe that certain events, actions, or objects—like the yield maps or drone reports—are specifically directed at you or meant to harm you, even if others don't see it that way?

Well... like I just said. Yes. 

My wife tries to show me the lender's paperwork, tells me it's just plain and normal. But... I know what I see. The odd numbers in those yield maps... the drone reports... they're coded warnings. I know folks are trying to take the farm out from under me. Doesn't matter if she doesn't see it. I just know.
Do you feel like other things in your daily life, outside of the farm reports, are also set up to send you hidden messages or harm you in some way?
No. Not that I've noticed. Just... just the farm. That's all.
